verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform, so ML fraud scoring and custom block/review/allow rules are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents fraud scores or a rules engine. Card validation (flutterwave-docs-14) and OTPs (flutterwave-docs-11) are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules
